name: ACE-Bench (Agentic Coding End-to-End)
description: Benchmark for evaluating autonomous coding agents on end-to-end feature development tasks from real repositories. Contains 212 feature development tasks extracted from 16 real GitHub repositories with 889 containerized Docker environments.
creator: Research team
notes: CRITICAL: Models achieving 70% on SWE-bench collapse to 7.5% on ACE-Bench, indicating a significant generalization gap. Features 889 Docker environments for containerized evaluation.
